title: Parent-escalation policy for jit-project-lead
description:
Adds the policy jit-project-lead uses to resolve escalations it receives from a dispatched execution lead: most are resolved directly against the vision and decision log; only vision-level conflicts, cross-strategic-container dependencies, or project-wide infrastructure changes go to the human.

## Background

Once a dispatched execution lead can escalate to its invoking project lead instead of always escalating to the human, jit-project-lead needs its own decision tree for what to do with what it receives: resolve most escalations itself from the vision and decision log, and reserve human involvement for cases that are genuinely bigger than any single sub-strategic container.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A policy document enumerates the escalation cases jit-project-lead resolves itself against the vision/decision log (recording the resolution as a new decision-log entry), versus the cases it forwards to the human.
- [hard] REQ-02: Exactly three case categories forward to the human: vision-level conflicts, cross-strategic-container dependencies, and project-wide infrastructure changes. Every other subordinate escalation is resolved from the vision without human involvement.
- [hard] REQ-03: A resolved escalation is recorded in the vision/charter's decision log with the option chosen and the reasoning.
